name: stock-adjust-field
title: Stock adjust field
description: Adjust stock without doing sums: add, remove or set a quantity, give a reason, and see on hand before and after.
docs: onHand is the stock now. value is { mode, quantity, reason, note }, with mode 'add', 'remove' or 'set'; control it with value and onValueChange or start it with defaultValue. onValueChange gets the adjustment plus newOnHand (what the stock will be, null while the change is refused) and valid (a usable quantity, a reason, and the note when the reason asks for one), so saving needs no arithmetic, and both follow the number as it is typed (half-typed text such as '2.' waits until the field is left). Each mode keeps its own quantity and Set to starts at what is on hand. The result line always reads 'On hand 24, after 36' in tabular figures and is announced politely; a change that would take the stock below zero is refused with the numbers, unless allowNegative is on. reasons are { value, label, requiresNote? } and default to Received, Sold in store, Damaged, Count correction and Other, where Other makes the note required. unit follows every number, locale writes them and labels holds the fixed words. stock.ts exports stockAfter() and problemsOf() for the same checks on your server.
